title: Update STU.LF to IFEP 2nd Query
description: Update STU.LF to IFEP 2nd Query - This will update the STU.LF to IFEP based on the Initial ELPAC test results once those are imported. Run Update STU.LF to IFEP 1st Query first.
code: CHANGE STU LAC STU.LF TO "I"   IF STU.LF = "T" AND LAC.ITF = "IFEP"
